title: Aye mere asghare jaani aaja
body:
AYE MERE ASGHAR JAANI AAJA
KAISE BHULAAOU TERA CHEHRA
TUJ BIN MADAR KAISE JIYEGI KAB TAK KHOON KEY AANSU PIYEGI….
MAA KHEKAR AAWAZ DO BETA…..
<<DIVIDER>>
MAA KHEKAR AAWAZ DO BETA, AYE MERE ASGHAR JAANI AJA
RAAT HAI KAALI DASHT HAI SUNA DARNA JAAO RUN MEIN TANHA…..
KABSE SADA DETI HAI DUKHIYAA…..
KABSE SADA DETI HAI DUKHIYAA, AYE MERE ASGHAR JAANI AJA
<<DIVIDER>>
PYAAR KARUN JHULE MEIN JHULAOUN LORI DEKAR TUJH KO SULAOU…..
TORDO NA DIL AAISE MERA…...
TORDO NA DIL AAISE MERA, AYE MERE ASGHAR JAANI AJA
ROTI HAI KABSE SAKINA QHAAK HUA HUMSAB KA JEENA…..
<<DIVIDER>>
SAB KO HAI BAS TERI TAMANNA…..
SAB KO HAI BAS TERI TAMANNA, AYE MERE ASGHAR JAANI AJA
THASHNA DHAN CHEMAAH KE MEHMAAN TERE KHUSHK LABAOU PE QURBAAN…..
IS TARHANA MUJHKO RULWA…..
<<DIVIDER>>
IS TARHANA MUJHKO RULWA, AYE MERE ASGHAR JAANI AJA
SABR KARE KAB TAK YEH MADAR DAAQ LIYE YEH TERA ASGHAR…..
DIL YE NAHIN HAI PHATTHAR MERA…..
DIL YE NAHIN HAI PHATTHAR MERA, AYE MERE ASGHAR JAANI AJA
<<DIVIDER>>
ROKE SOHAIL EK GHAM ZADA MADAR KEHTI THI ZAINAB SE LIPAT KAR…..
KHO GAYA MERA MANNATAO WALA…..
KHO GAYA MERA MANNATAO WALA, AYE MERE ASGHAR JAANI AJA
